channel.title: CarExpert Pty Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CarExpert Pty Ltd (carexpert.com.au)

item.title: 2026 Volkswagen ID.5 review
item.description: The new entry-level Volkswagen ID.5 electric SUV-coupe is much better value than the GTX, but isn't as much of a standout as its ID.4 sister model.

item.title: Next Mercedes-Benz A-Class to channel some of the spirit of the original – report
item.description: The next-generation Mercedes-Benz A-Class will reportedly have SUV and people mover elements rather being a straight-up hatchback.

item.title: BYD eyes fleets as next step to growing Australian sales
item.description: BYD wants to be a top three brand in Australia, and an increased focus on attracting fleet buyers is key to achieving this goal.

item.title: 2026 Mazda CX-5 receives raft of cost-cutting measures
item.description: Mazda has made some changes with its new CX-5, some of which you may see and touch, that are aimed at keeping its production costs down.

item.title: iPhone designer thinks touchscreens shouldn't be used for key car controls
item.description: The car industry got carried away with touchscreens, says the designer of the iPhone and the Ferrari Luce's interior, and they're the "wrong" tech for key vehicle controls.

item.title: 2026 Suzuki Across PHEV is a rebadged Toyota RAV4 that Australia won't get
item.description: The Across SUV adds new badges to Toyota's best-seller but it won’t threaten the RAV4’s Australian sales crown.

item.title: Chips down: Looming semiconductor shortage explained
item.description: Demand for advanced semiconductors by AI, and the phasing out of older computer chips, is mounting pressure – and costs – on the auto industry.

item.title: ANCAP calls for Australian ban on door handles used by Tesla, BYD and others
item.description: The boss of Australia’s automotive safety body has called for new laws in China to be adopted here without delay.

item.title: GWM's biggest SUV yet is a 5.3m-long luxury PHEV
item.description: GWM is launching its largest, most luxurious SUV yet in China under its premium Wey brand, but it's unclear if it'll come to Australia.

item.title: 2026 Volkswagen ID. Polo EV spied along with ID. Polo GTI electric hot hatch
item.description: Volkswagen will reveal the production ID. Polo EV this year, and the prototypes it's testing in the meantime are less disguised than ever.
